title: JHipster
description: JHipster — Universal Application Architect (public edition). Real documented tool; god-mode caveat applies.

In the context of the god-mode vision, it represents the current real-world state of the art for part of what "Universal Application Architect" aspires to do: Designs desktop, mobile, web, server, embedded, and AI applications from one coordinated specification..
